market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI mid-April 2026 high was ~$110/bbl during Strait of Hormuz tension peak; now back to ~$96. To hit $140 by end of June requires ~45% rally from current and ~27% above April high - would need major escalation. Possible but tail-risk.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A full Strait of Hormuz closure or broader Mideast war could spike prices fast.
